# Dooping Design Book

> The source of truth for a cross-project back-office design language: design tokens (npm: `@dooping/tokens`),
> React reference implementations (copied through the shadcn registry, not published as npm components), interaction patterns,
> and five page compositions. Downstream projects should take buttons and tables from here instead of reinventing them.
> Use `main` and the production site as the reference; `/preview/` is a work in progress.

- Machine-readable registry index: https://kielchang.github.io/dooping-design-book/r/index.json
  (`version` is the design version, `tokensVersion` is the paired token version, and `items[]` lists every component with
  `name`, `title`, `description`, and `url`; individual items are `/r/<name>.json`. Install with
  `npx shadcn@latest add <item URL>`.)
- AI/agent adoption contract: https://kielchang.github.io/dooping-design-book/AGENTS.md
- Four contracts that must not change: semantic color names and meanings; amber reserved for “changed but not submitted”;
  dark-mode hooks on `document.documentElement` (`.dark` or `[data-theme="dark"]`); and no meaning conveyed by color alone.
- Storybook (live component demos; interactive stories expose adjustable data in Controls):
  https://kielchang.github.io/dooping-design-book/storybook/

## Getting started

- [What this book is](https://kielchang.github.io/dooping-design-book/start/what-is-this/)
- [Three ways to adopt it](https://kielchang.github.io/dooping-design-book/start/three-ways/): read-only guidance, copied registry components, or tokens
- [Adoption checklist](https://kielchang.github.io/dooping-design-book/start/adoption-checklist/)

## Foundations (token layer)

- [Chapter index](https://kielchang.github.io/dooping-design-book/foundations/): semantic color, type, spacing, radius, elevation, motion,
  theming, palette selection, and alert-color vocabulary

## Components

- [Human-readable overview](https://kielchang.github.io/dooping-design-book/components/overview/)
- [Machine-readable item list](https://kielchang.github.io/dooping-design-book/r/index.json)

## Patterns (framework-neutral)

- [Chapter index](https://kielchang.github.io/dooping-design-book/patterns/): inline field editing, hard locks, audit and restore,
  effective-dated settings, data-table standards, empty states and deltas, print and export, screenshot-free docs,
  back-office information architecture, and feature flags
